name: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
shortDesc: Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns managed for pipeline, not just impressions.
whoFor: Businesses that need predictable leads or sales from Facebook and Instagram audiences.
benefits: Full account access and transparency
Creative testing built into every campaign
Spend optimized toward your actual sales, not clicks
No long-term lock-in contracts

faqService.q: How much ad spend do I need to start?
faqService.a: Most accounts see meaningful data starting around $1,000-$1,500/month in ad spend, separate from our management fee.

faqService.q: Do you write the ad creative or do I?
faqService.a: We handle strategy, copy and creative direction; you approve before anything goes live.

faqService.q: How is Meta Ads different from Google Ads for my business?
faqService.a: Meta reaches people based on interests and behavior before they're actively searching; Google Ads catches people already searching for what you sell.

name: Google Ads (Search, Display, PMax)
shortDesc: Search, Display and Performance Max campaigns built around cost-per-acquisition, not vanity clicks.
whoFor: Businesses with clear buyer intent - people already searching for what you offer.
benefits: Budgets protected from wasted clicks
Clear cost-per-lead reporting
Works alongside your SEO, not against it
Google Partner-level account management

faqService.q: Is Google Ads better than SEO for fast results?
faqService.a: Yes for speed - Google Ads can drive traffic the day it launches, while SEO typically takes 3-6 months to build momentum.

faqService.q: What's a realistic monthly budget?
faqService.a: It depends on your industry's cost-per-click, but we'll model this out in a free audit before you commit to a number.

faqService.q: Do you manage Performance Max separately from Search?
faqService.a: Yes - we structure PMax and Search as separate campaigns so PMax doesn't cannibalize your branded search traffic.

name: TikTok Ads
shortDesc: TikTok ad campaigns built around native, scroll-stopping creative rather than repurposed banner ads.
whoFor: Brands targeting younger audiences or selling visually engaging products.
benefits: Creative that doesn't feel like an ad
Lower CPMs than most other platforms currently
Fast creative iteration cycles
Direct integration with TikTok Shop where relevant

faqService.q: Do I need to make my own TikTok videos?
faqService.a: We can direct and edit creative for you, though authentic in-app style footage usually performs best - we'll guide you on what to film.

faqService.q: Is TikTok Ads worth it for a B2B business?
faqService.a: It depends on your audience - we'll tell you honestly in an audit if TikTok fits your buyer, rather than sell you a platform that doesn't.

faqService.q: How does TikTok Shop integration work?
faqService.a: If you sell products, we can connect your catalog directly so ads lead to in-app checkout, reducing drop-off.

name: LinkedIn Ads (for B2B clients)
shortDesc: LinkedIn campaigns built for B2B pipelines - lead gen forms, sponsored content and ABM targeting.
whoFor: B2B and SaaS companies selling to a defined list of companies or job titles.
benefits: Built for long B2B sales cycles, not instant sales
Direct sync with your CRM for lead follow-up
Account-based targeting down to named companies
Reporting tied to pipeline, not just leads

faqService.q: Why is LinkedIn Ads more expensive than Meta or Google?
faqService.a: LinkedIn's targeting is by job title and company, which is more valuable data - so CPCs are higher but lead quality for B2B is usually much better.

faqService.q: Can you target a specific list of companies?
faqService.a: Yes - Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns let you upload a target account list and show ads only to people at those companies.

faqService.q: Do Lead Gen Forms work better than sending traffic to our site?
faqService.a: Usually yes for LinkedIn specifically, since forms pre-fill with the user's profile data and remove friction.

name: Retargeting/Remarketing Campaigns
shortDesc: Retargeting campaigns across Meta and Google that bring back visitors who didn't convert the first time.
whoFor: Any business with website traffic that isn't converting on the first visit.
benefits: Recovers revenue you're already paying to acquire
Usually your lowest cost-per-conversion channel
Works across every device a visitor used
Integrates with your existing pixel data

faqService.q: Isn't retargeting the same as just running more ads?
faqService.a: No - retargeting only shows ads to people who've already visited your site, which is why it typically converts at 2-3x the rate of cold traffic.

faqService.q: How do you avoid annoying repeat visitors?
faqService.a: We cap ad frequency and rotate creative so the same person doesn't see the same ad dozens of times.

faqService.q: Do you need Meta and Google to be connected?
faqService.a: No - we run them as separate but coordinated campaigns so we're not double-counting the same conversion.

name: Local SEO / Google Business Profile Optimization
shortDesc: Local search and Google Maps visibility for businesses that depend on nearby customers finding them.
whoFor: Any business with a physical location or a defined local service area.
benefits: Improves visibility in the Google Maps 3-pack
Builds trust through reviews and accurate listings
Compounds over time unlike paid ads
Especially strong ROI for service-area businesses

faqService.q: How long does local SEO take to show results?
faqService.a: Most businesses see initial map-pack movement within 60-90 days, with stronger gains by month 4-6.

faqService.q: Do you handle review responses too?
faqService.a: We can set up a review-generation system and provide response templates; whether we post replies ourselves is a service add-on.

faqService.q: What if I have multiple locations?
faqService.a: We handle multi-location profiles as a coordinated set so listings stay consistent and don't compete with each other.

name: Technical SEO Audits
shortDesc: A full technical diagnostic of your site's crawlability, speed and indexing health.
whoFor: Sites with stalled organic traffic, recent redesigns, or unexplained ranking drops.
benefits: Finds issues invisible in normal analytics
Prevents future ranking drops before launch
Often the fastest way to unlock stalled rankings
Delivered as a clear, prioritized action list

faqService.q: How is this different from a free online SEO checker?
faqService.a: Automated checkers flag surface issues; we manually verify what's actually hurting your rankings versus what's cosmetic noise.

faqService.q: Do you also fix the issues you find?
faqService.a: Yes, or we hand the prioritized list to your existing developer - either way works.

faqService.q: How often should a technical audit be repeated?
faqService.a: Roughly every 6-12 months, or immediately after any site migration or major redesign.

name: On-page & Content SEO
shortDesc: Keyword-mapped page structure and content built to earn rankings, not just include keywords.
whoFor: Businesses whose pages aren't ranking despite having decent content.
benefits: Content built around real search intent
Improves both rankings and time-on-page
Reduces keyword cannibalization across your site
Feeds long-term topical authority

faqService.q: Do you write new content or optimize what I have?
faqService.a: Both - we audit existing pages first, then recommend which to optimize versus which need new content entirely.

faqService.q: How many keywords can one page realistically target?
faqService.a: Usually one primary keyword plus 3-5 closely related terms; spreading further dilutes relevance.

faqService.q: Will AI-generated content hurt my rankings?
faqService.a: Poorly-edited AI content can, since it often reads as generic; we write and edit everything for genuine expertise and specificity.

name: Link Building
shortDesc: Editorial backlinks earned through outreach, guest posts and digital PR - never link farms.
whoFor: Sites competing in industries where content alone isn't enough to rank.
benefits: Builds domain authority that compounds over years
Every link vetted for real relevance and quality
No risk of manual penalties from spammy tactics
Tracks competitor link velocity, not just your own

faqService.q: How many links do I actually need?
faqService.a: It depends on your competitors' link profiles - we benchmark this in the first month rather than quote a generic number.

faqService.q: Do you guarantee specific domain authority scores?
faqService.a: No reputable agency can guarantee a DA score since it's a third-party metric outside anyone's control - we focus on real referral traffic and rankings instead.

faqService.q: Is guest posting still effective in 2026?
faqService.a: Yes, when done on genuinely relevant, real-traffic sites - it's the mass, low-quality version of guest posting that stopped working.

name: Motion Graphics & Video Editing
shortDesc: Motion graphics and video editing for ads, explainers and social content.
whoFor: Brands that need scroll-stopping video but don't have an in-house editor.
benefits: Cuts built for retention, not just polish
Fast turnaround for ad-testing cycles
Consistent visual style across every asset
Formats delivered ready for every platform

faqService.q: Do you shoot original footage or only edit?
faqService.a: We primarily edit and animate; for original filming we can direct a local shoot or work from your existing footage/stock.

faqService.q: How fast is turnaround on a single video?
faqService.a: Typically 3-5 business days depending on complexity and revision rounds.

faqService.q: Can you match our existing brand style?
faqService.a: Yes - we start by studying your existing assets so new video feels like the same brand, not a new one.

name: Graphic Design

whoFor: Businesses that need consistent, professional design without hiring in-house.
benefits: One consistent visual language across channels
Fast turnaround for recurring requests
Source files delivered, not just exports
Scales up or down with your monthly volume

faqService.q: Do you offer unlimited design requests?
faqService.a: We offer tiered monthly retainers with a set number of requests/revisions - ask about volume that matches your needs.

faqService.q: Can you work from our existing brand guidelines?
faqService.a: Yes - if you don't have formal guidelines yet, we can also build a lightweight one first.

faqService.q: What file formats do we receive?
faqService.a: Editable source files (Figma/AI/PSD) plus exported, ready-to-use formats for every platform you need.

name: Content Writing / Copywriting
shortDesc: Website, ad and email copy written to convert, not just fill space.
whoFor: Businesses whose current copy reads generic or isn't converting visitors.
benefits: Copy grounded in your actual customers' language
SEO and conversion goals built in from the start
One consistent voice across every channel
Edited by a human, every time

faqService.q: Do you write for our specific industry?
faqService.a: Yes - we research your market and customers before writing anything; we don't reuse generic templates across clients.

faqService.q: Is the content SEO-optimized by default?
faqService.a: Yes for anything meant to rank; we separate SEO-first writing from pure conversion/ad copy since the goals differ.

faqService.q: Can you match our existing brand voice?
faqService.a: We start every engagement by studying your existing copy and building a short tone-of-voice guide before writing anything new.

name: Branding & Identity Design (logo, brand kit)
shortDesc: Logo, visual identity and brand guidelines built to look credible from day one.
whoFor: New businesses launching, or existing ones outgrowing a DIY logo.
benefits: A brand that looks credible to investors and customers alike
Guidelines that keep every future designer consistent
Built to scale as you add products or markets
Delivered as ready-to-use files, not just concepts

faqService.q: How long does a full branding project take?
faqService.a: Typically 3-4 weeks from discovery to final delivery, depending on revision rounds.

faqService.q: Do you also design our website once branding is done?
faqService.a: Yes - branding and website design are commonly bundled since consistency matters most in that handoff.

faqService.q: What if we already have a logo we like?
faqService.a: We can build a full brand system around an existing logo rather than starting from zero.

name: Short-form video content (Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

whoFor: Brands wanting consistent short-form presence without an in-house creator.
benefits: Built around retention data, not guesswork
Consistent posting without the daily workload
UGC-style content that doesn't feel like an ad
Cross-posted to Reels, TikTok and Shorts from one shoot

faqService.q: Do we need to appear on camera ourselves?
faqService.a: Not necessarily - we can work with UGC creators or product-only formats if founder-facing content isn't a fit.

faqService.q: How many videos per month is realistic?
faqService.a: Most brands see traction posting 3-5 times per week; we'll set a realistic cadence based on your resources.

faqService.q: Do you handle the actual filming?
faqService.a: We can direct a local shoot, source UGC creators, or edit footage you already have - whichever fits your setup.

name: Social Media Management (posting, community management)
shortDesc: Day-to-day posting, scheduling and community management across your social channels.
whoFor: Businesses that know they need consistent social presence but don't have time to run it.
benefits: Consistent posting without you lifting a finger
Community replies handled in your brand voice
Performance tracked against real business goals
Frees up your time for the parts only you can do

faqService.q: Which platforms do you manage?
faqService.a: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and X most commonly - we'll recommend which actually matter for your audience.

faqService.q: Do you reply to DMs and comments?
faqService.a: Yes, community management is included; anything requiring sensitive judgment gets flagged to you directly.

faqService.q: Who creates the content we post?
faqService.a: We handle strategy and scheduling; content can be produced by our creative team as an add-on or supplied by you.

name: Social Media Marketing/Strategy
shortDesc: The strategy layer behind social - positioning, content pillars and growth planning.
whoFor: Brands with an active presence that isn't translating into real growth.
benefits: A plan tied to business goals, not just follower count
Clarity on which platforms deserve your effort
Benchmarked against real competitors
Revisited quarterly as the market shifts

faqService.q: Is this the same as social media management?
faqService.a: No - this is the strategy behind it; we often pair it with management, but strategy alone works for teams with in-house posting.

faqService.q: How do you measure success beyond followers?
faqService.a: We track engagement rate, traffic driven to your site, and where relevant, leads or sales attributed to social.

faqService.q: How often does strategy get revisited?
faqService.a: Quarterly by default, with faster check-ins if a platform's algorithm or your market shifts significantly.

Contracts and usage rights handled properly
Performance tracked, not just posted-and-forgotten

faqService.q: How do you find the right creators?
faqService.a: We vet based on audience overlap and genuine engagement rate, not just follower count, which is often inflated or irrelevant.

faqService.q: Can we reuse creator content in our own ads?
faqService.a: Only with usage rights built into the contract upfront, which we always negotiate for as standard.

name: Lead Generation Campaigns

whoFor: Service businesses and B2B companies that need a steady pipeline of qualified leads.

faqService.q: What counts as a 'qualified' lead?
faqService.a: We define this together upfront - budget, timeline, and fit criteria - so we're optimizing toward leads worth your sales team's time.

faqService.q: Which channels do you use for lead gen?
faqService.a: Typically a mix of paid ads, landing pages and email follow-up, chosen based on where your specific audience actually is.

faqService.q: How fast do leads get to us?
faqService.a: In real time via CRM integration or instant notification, so follow-up speed doesn't cost you the sale.

name: Landing Page Design & CRO (conversion rate optimization)
shortDesc: High-converting landing pages built and tested against your actual conversion data.
whoFor: Anyone sending paid or organic traffic to a page that isn't converting well.
benefits: Pages built to convert the specific traffic you're sending
Testing removes guesswork from design decisions
Often the highest-ROI fix available
Improves ROI on ad spend you're already paying for

faqService.q: How much can CRO actually improve conversion rate?
faqService.a: It varies widely, but even modest 10-20% lifts compound significantly across your existing traffic and ad spend.

faqService.q: Do you need a minimum amount of traffic to test?
faqService.a: Yes - meaningful A/B tests need enough volume to reach statistical significance; we'll advise if your traffic supports formal testing yet.

faqService.q: Can you redesign our existing page or must it be new?
faqService.a: Either - most engagements start with auditing and improving what exists before considering a full rebuild.

name: Email Marketing & Automation (Klaviyo/Mailchimp/HubSpot)
shortDesc: Email flows and campaigns that turn your list into a real revenue channel.
whoFor: Businesses with an email list that isn't being used systematically yet.
deliverables: A/B testing of subject lines & sends
benefits: Automated flows work while you sleep
Segmentation means fewer, better-targeted emails
Often your highest-ROI marketing channel
Built on the platform you already use

faqService.q: Which email platform do you work with?
faqService.a: Klaviyo, Mailchimp and HubSpot most commonly - we'll work within your existing platform rather than force a migration.

faqService.q: What's the difference between flows and campaigns?
faqService.a: Flows are automated (triggered by behavior, like an abandoned cart); campaigns are one-off sends like a promotion or newsletter - we build both.

faqService.q: How much revenue can email realistically drive?
faqService.a: For e-commerce specifically, well-built flows alone commonly drive double-digit percentages of total revenue.

name: SMS Marketing
shortDesc: Text message campaigns and automations that reach customers where they already are.
whoFor: E-commerce and retail businesses wanting a direct, high-open-rate channel.
benefits: Open rates far higher than email
Direct, immediate channel for time-sensitive offers
Fully compliant opt-in and opt-out handling
Works alongside email, not instead of it

faqService.q: Is SMS marketing legally complicated?
faqService.a: There are real compliance requirements (consent, opt-out language) which we build in from day one so you're not exposed.

faqService.q: How often should we text customers?
faqService.a: Far less often than email - most successful programs send a few times a month, reserving SMS for genuinely time-sensitive messages.

faqService.q: Do you handle list growth too?
faqService.a: Yes - we set up on-site and post-purchase opt-in flows so your list grows compliantly alongside the campaigns.

name: Website Design (WordPress, Webflow, Shopify)

whoFor: Businesses needing a new site or a redesign that doesn't fall over under real traffic.
benefits: Built on the platform that fits your actual needs
Fast load times built in, not bolted on after
You retain full ownership and access
Trained to manage content yourself after launch

faqService.q: Which platform is right for us - WordPress, Webflow or Shopify?
faqService.a: It depends on whether you need e-commerce (Shopify), content flexibility (WordPress), or design-first marketing sites (Webflow) - we'll recommend based on your actual needs.

faqService.q: How long does a full website take?
faqService.a: Typically 4-8 weeks depending on page count and complexity.

faqService.q: Can we update the site ourselves after launch?
faqService.a: Yes - we build with a CMS and provide training so you're not dependent on us for every text change.

name: SaaS Development

whoFor: Founders and companies building a software product, not just a marketing site.
benefits: MVP-first approach to validate before overbuilding
Built on modern, maintainable tech stacks
Transparent sprint-based delivery
Support doesn't end at launch

faqService.a: We use proven modern frameworks rather than reinventing infrastructure - this keeps cost and timeline realistic.

faqService.q: How long does an MVP take?
faqService.a: Most MVPs take 8-14 weeks depending on scope, prioritizing the smallest version that proves your core value.

faqService.q: Who owns the code once it's built?
faqService.a: You do, fully - we hand over complete source code and documentation.

name: App Development (mobile)

whoFor: Businesses needing a mobile app for customers, staff, or a product idea.

Clear milestone-based delivery

faqService.q: Should we build native or cross-platform?
faqService.a: Cross-platform (e.g. React Native) covers most use cases at lower cost; native makes sense mainly for performance-heavy or hardware-specific apps.

faqService.q: How long does app store approval take?
faqService.a: Typically 1-2 weeks for Apple, faster for Android, though this varies and first submissions sometimes need revisions.

faqService.q: What happens after launch?
faqService.a: We offer ongoing maintenance plans for updates, OS compatibility and bug fixes - apps need upkeep, not just a launch.

name: E-commerce Store Setup & Management

No dependency on us for routine updates
Payment and shipping configured correctly the first time
Scales as your product catalog grows

faqService.a: Shopify suits most businesses wanting speed and reliability with less technical overhead; WooCommerce suits those wanting deeper WordPress-based customization.

faqService.q: Can you migrate our existing store?
faqService.a: Yes - we handle product, customer and order data migration with minimal downtime.

faqService.q: Do you handle ongoing maintenance after launch?
faqService.a: Yes, as an optional monthly plan covering updates, security and small changes.

faqService.q: Can you migrate our data from spreadsheets?

faqService.q: Do you provide training for our team?

Built on the tools you already use

faqService.q: Do we need a certain size team to benefit?
faqService.a: No - even solo founders benefit since it removes manual follow-up tasks that otherwise get missed.

faqService.a: Platform analytics are useful but limited to that platform; GA4 gives a full-site, cross-channel view that platform tools can't.

faqService.q: Can you build a dashboard from data we already have?
